_comment: Phase 11 — cost + health alerts, deliberately minimal (see infra/azure/README.md 'Cost + health alerts' section for what was left out and why). notificationEmail reuses the existing admin-notification address (info@akerogarden.se) rather than a new mailbox, per 2026-07-22 decision. Run any time after main.bicep — no dependency on a code redeploy. CORRECTED 2026-07-22: monthlyBudgetAmount is in SEK, not USD — this subscription bills in SEK (confirmed via `az consumption budget show ... currentSpend.unit`), and Microsoft.Consumption/budgets has no currency property to override that. The original 60 was entered assuming USD and was live for a short window; 600 SEK (~$60 at ~9.7 SEK/USD, 2026-07-22) actually covers the ~$45/mo (~440 SEK) real spend with headroom. budgetStartDate is PINNED to the budget's real start (2026-07-01) rather than left to the template default, which is utcNow('yyyy-MM-01') and therefore moves the start date forward on every single apply — drift manufactured by the template itself. Pinning it makes a re-apply idempotent for the budget. Harmless either way for a monthly budget, since the tracked period is the calendar month regardless, but Azure can reject a start-date change on an existing budget and there is no reason to find out.
